details.publicNotes:
Wripies are mischievous fey that delight in pulling pranks. They believe that levity is the key to enjoying life and find boredom the most intolerable emotion of all. Unfortunately, wripies are quickly bored by repetitive tasks, leading them to believe that disrupting other people engaged in such activities is doing them a favor. However, the same people who greet their pranks with merry laughter at a party are far less likely to be good-natured after a wripie's hijinks have ruined a day's work. The more praise their pranks receive, the more they are encouraged to scale up their mayhem. But if a wripie's pranks are met with anger or hostility, they might conclude that violent pranks are the best way to resonate with their audience. Wripies recognize that the lives of others are fragile, and they take care to ensure that even their most painful schemes don't cause lethal harm.

Wripies' flashiest trick is to create and puppet duplicates of their own bodies. While wripies certainly don't enjoy pain, they appear to have no fear of death. When a wripie is mortally wounded, their body vanishes in a cloud of green smoke. Whether this vanishing act is a great escape, an unusual death, or even an indication that wripies are puppets of a yet greater fey mastermind is a question no wripie would dare to answer.

Spring Fools

Wripies hold the first day of each season as sacred—a day where work should be set aside and merriment must reign. They try to help others remember this fact by ruining any work that is undertaken, scattering harvests, spilling ink on manuscripts, and using their whips to snatch tools from an artisan's hands. The best way to rid oneself of a wripie on a first-of-the-season pranking spree is to play a trick in return: with a salute of admiration, a pranked wripie will disappear in a puff of green smoke.

Suggested Monster Parts

Monster Parts 5/12/22 gp

Eligible Refinements weapons (piercing, slashing), armor (light), perception item, skill items (Acrobatics, Athletics, Deception, Medicine, Nature, Performance, Stealth, Survival, Thievery)

Eligible Imbued Properties bane, charisma, constitution, dexterity, elongating, energy resistant (vitality), sensory (low-light vision), space, space shield, spiked, tangle shield, wild, wood

description.value: The wripie deals 1d6 extra precision damage to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} creatures.

Trigger A creature targets the wripie with an attack and they can see the attacker, and the wripie is with 30 feet of at least one of their copies

Effect The wripie swap places with a copy within 30 feet. If the attack hits the copy, the copy explodes, spraying razor-sharp flower petals in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:5]. All non-wripie creatures in the area take @Damage[2d6[slashing]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:16|basic] save).

The wripie creates a duplicate of themselves within 30 feet. This copy has the same statistics as the wripie, but disappears if it takes any damage. The wripie and all of their copies share their actions and multiple attack penalty. A creature that Seeks can determine of a wripie is real or a copy with a successful @Check[perception|dc:18] check. A copy lasts for 1 minute. A wripie can maintain up three copies of themselves at a time; if they create a new copy while three copies are active, the oldest copy disappears.

With an explosion of flower petals, the wripies burst into motion. The wripie and all of their copies Stride, gaining the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} condition during this movement.

Trigger The wripie is reduced to 0 Hit Points

Effect The wripie decides if their foes have been good sports or poor sports when dealing with their pranks before disappearing, leaving behind a @Template[type:emanation|distance:20] of green smoke.

Good Sports The emanation fills with soft flower petals and soothing smells. Each creature in the area heals @Damage[2d8[healing]|options:area-damage] Hit Points.

Poor Sports The emanation fills with thorned vines, dealing @Damage[2d6[slashing]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:16|basic] save). The area becomes difficult terrain. If the terrain is not a viable environment for the vines, they wither after 24 hours.
All damage that a wripie deals is nonlethal unless they consciously decide to deal lethal damage.
